evidence_status: Designed research backlog; no runtime feature is claimed built.
selection_policy: Preserve the active release sequence. First compare the existing-object slices by concrete play and expert tasks; promote one bounded slice, not the whole backlog.

items.title: Keep the object, expose the calculation
items.core_seam: Studio creations and Route Lab saved state
items.gesture: Move a curve crossing or a route point and pin a comparison without leaving the scene.
items.game: Make two different-looking creations share a measured property, or improve a route and keep the witness.
items.expert_workflow: Inspect values, units, domains, method status, resource limits and export replayable numeric data.
items.validation: A saved object reopens with the same calculation inputs across App, CLI and MCP; unsupported cases are explicit.
items.scope: No second expression parser, persistence format owner, or general notebook.
items.revisit_or_reject: Reject a universal result schema that erases operation-specific evidence.

items.title: Make a network, challenge its answer
items.core_seam: Route Lab maps, route comparisons, later typed finite graphs
items.gesture: Close a road or change its cost and see the route reorganize.
items.game: Design a tiny map that defeats a heuristic; trade a counterexample and repair it.
items.expert_workflow: Compare exact bounded baselines with heuristics; later inspect degree-preserving moves, transitions and walk statistics.
items.validation: Recompute cost and feasibility independently; round-trip the full graph including directedness and edge semantics.
items.scope: Route certificates first; scheduling and subgroup posets are different adapters, never relabeled road maps.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if imported graph semantics silently change or a heuristic gains an optimality label.

items.title: A wave becomes a message
items.core_seam: Studio coefficient sequences, harmonic sound and future sequence analysis
items.gesture: Flip or drag coefficients and hear a declared timbre mapping while correlation peaks change.
items.game: Build a quiet sidelobe pattern or send a friend's drawing through a chosen noisy channel.
items.expert_workflow: Export exact finite coefficients, correlation conventions, normalization and seeded channel trials.
items.validation: Check direct sums on tiny sequences, complex conjugation and boundary conventions; playback loudness remains bounded.
items.scope: A short sequence/correlation instrument first; communications capacity is a separate mathematical claim.
items.revisit_or_reject: Revise if audio is decoration or uncontrolled loudness masks the mathematical change.

items.title: A curve you can question
items.core_seam: Existing Studio expression and slider objects
items.gesture: Drag a bracket around a moving zero; watch the crossing answer immediately.
items.game: Find parameters giving a chosen crossing, slope or area; ignore the challenge and draw freely.
items.expert_workflow: Bracketed root finding and bounded parameter sweeps on the supported grammar, with endpoint/domain checks and sample export.
items.validation: Endpoint zeros, no sign change, discontinuities, non-finite values and cancellation have separate outcomes; brackets carry the continuity assumptions.
items.scope: One root operation first; fitting, integration and symbolic calculus each need a later contract.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if the same expression is interpreted differently by the plot and the calculator.

items.title: Transformations with receipts
items.core_seam: New bounded finite matrix object in core
items.gesture: Pull a shape's axes or edit entries; follow the transformed grid and selected vectors.
items.game: Undo a deformation, preserve an area or construct two transformations that fail to commute.
items.expert_workflow: Small real matrix products, solves and selected decompositions with residuals, conditioning and precision limits.
items.validation: Verify exact small fixtures and independent residuals; handle singular/repeated/ill-conditioned inputs and preserve basis conventions.
items.scope: Small real matrices first; complex channels, sparse operators and semidefinite optimization are separate extensions.
items.revisit_or_reject: Reject a broad solver dependency until ownership, determinism and numerical failure behavior are explicit.

items.title: Make randomness inspectable
items.core_seam: Bounded finite distributions, seeded sampling and declared transition kernels
items.gesture: Reweight a handful of outcomes or move a transition and watch a repeatable ensemble respond.
items.game: Invent a fair guessing game or discover two mechanisms that look similar in small samples.
items.expert_workflow: Compare exact finite expectations with seeded estimates, uncertainty summaries and mixing diagnostics under a declared sampling law.
items.validation: Finite enumeration baselines, probability normalization, seed replay and explicit correlated-sample handling; no universal convergence claim from a short run.
items.scope: Finite distributions and one chosen walk first; continuum probability and inferred statistical models need separate contracts.
items.revisit_or_reject: Reject an unexplained sampling bias or a confidence label without its assumptions.

items.title: Sculpt the ruler
items.core_seam: Exact finite polygons, declared origin and norm
items.gesture: Pull a polygon and watch its polar and distance circles respond.
items.game: Balance vectors inside a chosen unit ball or make a short path become long by changing its ruler.
items.expert_workflow: Inspect support functions, dual norms, polygon products and finite metric/embedding witnesses.
items.validation: Exact rational polygon fixtures, origin-interiority checks and explicit degeneracy behavior; preserve scale and norm conventions.
items.scope: Two-dimensional exact constructions first; high-dimensional theorems remain context.
items.revisit_or_reject: Reject forced connections to cosmological expansion or generic category rooms based on names alone.

items.title: Build a space and inspect its invariant
items.core_seam: Finite complexes, coefficient domains and exact boundary matrices
items.gesture: Snap cells together and remove a free face while cycles rearrange.
items.game: Build different shapes with equal checked homology, then discover what the invariant misses.
items.expert_workflow: Compute bounded boundary operators and homology; inspect move certificates, subgroup chains and signed cancellations.
items.validation: Check boundary squared equals zero, coefficient selection and explicit small complexes; reject malformed incidence data.
items.scope: Finite combinatorial objects first; smooth four-manifold and chromatic claims are specialist lenses.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if equal homology is presented as equivalent spaces or a planar knot models arbitrary four-dimensional geometry.

items.title: Arrange exact arithmetic
items.core_seam: Bounded integers, rationals and finite search witnesses
items.gesture: Arrange reciprocal pieces or prime patterns and see exact relations close.
items.game: Find a decomposition, trade a finite counterexample or compose a numerical mosaic.
items.expert_workflow: Export exact fractions, divisibility witnesses, bounded search results and explicit limits.
items.validation: Independent arithmetic fixtures, overflow/resource handling and seeded/replayable enumeration.
items.scope: Small exact domains first; enormous asymptotic constants are not a practical algorithm.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if finite searches imply universal number-theoretic conclusions.

items.title: Make a drawing travel
items.core_seam: New bounded mass distributions and finite coupling object
items.gesture: Paint two piles of light and move mass between them with visible conservation.
items.game: Make a surprising morph or find a cheaper way to meet the same destinations.
items.expert_workflow: Inspect a tiny coupling table, marginal residuals, cost and regularization; compare with a deterministic assignment.
items.validation: Tiny rational instances have independently checked feasible/optimal baselines; distinguish plan, map and numerical interpolation.
items.scope: Start with a finite grid and declared cost; continuum map regularity is source context.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if a beautiful interpolation loses mass or conceals splitting.

items.title: Tiles, bubbles and boundaries
items.core_seam: Typed finite tile states and separately defined periodic geometry
items.gesture: Flip a legal tile, sculpt a periodic bubble or paint a boundary that settles.
items.game: Make a mountain, preserve a winding rule or challenge a proposed low-perimeter shape.
items.expert_workflow: Export boundary conventions, energy/area, legal moves and sampling diagnostics; compare analytic candidate families.
items.validation: Legality and invariants are exact for discrete states; periodic area estimates expose mesh refinement and candidate restrictions.
items.scope: Tile landscapes and periodic bubbles are separate bounded prototypes; no arbitrary minimal-surface solver.
items.revisit_or_reject: Reject a claimed sampler with unexplained bias or a candidate comparison labeled global proof.

items.title: Hear and see a chosen operator
items.core_seam: Declared domain, operator, boundary conditions and modes
items.gesture: Reshape a domain and trace a mode's quiet lines; optionally compose with it.
items.game: Keep a nodal pattern while changing the shape, or build a visual score.
items.expert_workflow: Inspect eigenpairs, residuals, discretization and convergence; export mesh and operator with readings.
items.validation: Analytic reference domains and mesh comparisons constrain error; distinguish membrane, plate, heat and spherical operators.
items.scope: Start with one operator and a bounded mesh; audio mapping is explicit rather than asserted physics.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if changing boundary conditions is treated as a palette change or a residual is called an error bound without assumptions.

items.title: Programs you can play backward
items.core_seam: Exact finite maps and reversible gate compositions
items.gesture: Arrange gates, release a tracer and run the finite program backward.
items.game: Route a message around obstacles or build a small reversible puzzle for a partner.
items.expert_workflow: Inspect state transitions, inverse composition and the invariant each gate preserves.
items.validation: Round-trip every bounded state for tiny circuits; distinguish planar area from compensated spatial volume.
items.scope: Finite maps before continuous flow; arbitrary halting and robust continuum universality stay out of scope.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if a visual fluid metaphor hides irreversible truncation or changes the detector definition.

items.title: Exact constructions you can inspect
items.core_seam: Bounded sparse polynomials, finite algebras and explicit certificate readers
items.gesture: Change a small polynomial or finite table and see which relation survives.
items.game: Build a tiny example that separates two invariants, or repair a failed identity.
items.expert_workflow: Recompute finite recurrences, signed boundary cancellations or positivity witnesses with explicit coefficient domains and nonreduced structure.
items.validation: Check exact identities independently, preserve ideals rather than only zero sets, and report degree, coefficient and enumeration limits.
items.scope: Select one source construction and one finite domain; no general computer algebra system or automatic theorem prover.
items.revisit_or_reject: Defer if the claimed certificate cannot be reconstructed from explicit source data.

items.title: A flow whose boundaries you can test
items.core_seam: Bounded explicit vector fields, event states and selected exact polynomial checks
items.gesture: Place a seed in a small flow box and watch its path answer changes to the field.
items.game: Find an escaping trajectory or construct a box whose checked faces keep paths inside.
items.expert_workflow: Inspect a source-specified low-dimensional ODE, equilibria, face signs, trajectories and step refinement with declared parameter restrictions.
items.validation: Exact polynomial boundary fixtures and equilibrium checks sit beside numerical trajectories; report solver limits and distinguish tangency from inward crossing.
items.scope: One explicit field before an arbitrary-equation interface; sections of a high-dimensional geometric object remain sections.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if an attractive trajectory is mistaken for a global existence or stability proof.

items.title: Feel an unseen interior
items.core_seam: One bounded forward model plus noisy measurements
items.gesture: Send a probe, watch its response and move a guess about the hidden shape.
items.game: Hide a simple inclusion for another player to discover with a limited probe budget.
items.expert_workflow: Explore sensitivity, regularization and non-identifiability through repeatable forward/inverse comparisons.
items.validation: Recover only within a declared model; include ambiguous examples, noise sweeps and residuals on held-out measurements.
items.scope: Choose one tractable finite model before a room; rough-coefficient uniqueness is not implied.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if the experience rewards a single hidden answer when measurements admit several.

items.title: A place to stay with the instrument
items.core_seam: CLI presentation over existing core requests
items.gesture: Nudge a parameter, switch plot/table views and keep a comparison without restarting a command.
items.game: Follow a self-chosen investigation or challenge with keyboard-only reversible actions.
items.expert_workflow: Cancellable sweeps, readable exact input, structured export, focus and terminal restoration.
items.validation: Same inputs/results across CLI, TUI and MCP; resize, interruption, no-color and narrow layouts retain meaning.
items.scope: TUI stays inside the CLI face after core operations justify it; no new mathematical backend.
items.revisit_or_reject: Stop if persistence or numerical rules migrate into presentation code.

items.title: Preserve specialist constructions without forcing a room
items.gesture: Offer a faithful finite prerequisite or an inspectable construction only when its connection is explained.
items.game: Let a player pose a question, keep an example or compare two models without fabricated scoring.
items.expert_workflow: Retain source locators, reusable assets, transfer boundaries and unresolved questions for later work.
items.validation: Every indexed paper has a source-grounded disposition; theorem claims and design inferences are visibly distinct.
items.scope: A tracked research destination, not a promise to implement every paper or a claim of exhausted insight.
items.revisit_or_reject: Promote only after an actual bounded object and worthwhile action emerge; otherwise retain the research lens.

items.title: Keep the difficult remainder visible
items.game: No game is claimed until a faithful model is found.
items.expert_workflow: Preserve the obstacle and the next question that could change the decision.
items.validation: A specific paper-level reason explains deferral and the condition for revisiting it.
items.scope: High-dimensional, inaccessible or impractical constructions can remain deferred indefinitely.
items.revisit_or_reject: Do not convert lack of understanding into a decorative visualization.
